translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Maarotaa Demanaw Woosaa
Abeet Med'inaa Godaw, nu bolla gakkeeddawaa ubbaa hassaya; nuuna s'eella; nu kawushshaakka be'a!
Nu laata biittay allagatoo, nu golliikka betetoo imetteedda.
Nuuni aawuu hayk'k'eedda naanatuwaa gideeddo; nu aayetuukka am"e mac'c'a asaa gideeddino.
Nu ushiyaa haatsaw miishshaa c'iggeeto; eetsiyaa mitsaakka shammi akkeetto.
Nuuna yederssiyaawanttu nu ginddiyaa s'ap'uwaa gakkeeddino. Nuuni daabureeddo, shin shemppanaw danddayibeykko.
Nuuni k'uma kallana giide, Gibs'e asatoonne Asoore asatoo kushiyaa immeeddo.
Nagaraa ootseeddawanttu nu mayzza aawotuwaa; shin unttunttu ha"i de'ikkino. Unttunttu akkanaw bessiyaa muruwaa akkiyaawanttu nuuna.
Ayiletuu nuuna mooddiyaawantta gideeddino; unttunttu kushiyaappekka nuuna wotsi akkiyaawe ittuunne baawa.
Mashshaan wod'iyaawanttu bazzuwaan de'iyaa diraw, nuuni nu shemppuwaa sheneko giide, nu k'umaa demmeeddo.
Koshay suulleedda gaasuwaan harggina, nu galbbay tamaa c'ooc'iyaadan michchee.
S'iyoonen mac'c'a asatuwaa, Yihudaa katamatuwaankka wodorotuwaa wolk'k'an oyk'k'iide bayzzeeddino.
Kaappatuwaa afiide kak'k'eeddino; c'imatuukka bonchchettibeykkino.
Yalaga attuma asatuu wos'aan gaac'c'eeddino; attuma naanatuukka dees'o mitsaa tookkiide ganddigaareeddino.
C'ima asatuu katamaa penggen pirddanaw uttiyaawaa aggeeddino; yalaga attuma asatuu yetsaa yes's'iyaawaa aggeeddino.
Nu wozanaappe nashechchay bi kichcheedda; nu durussaykka yeekoo laametteedda;
kallachchay nu huup'iyaappe kunddi kichcheedda. Nuuni nagaraa ootseedda diraw, nuw aayye ana!
Hewaa diraw, nu wozanay daabureedda; nu ayifiikka galjjeedda.
Ayaw gooppe, S'iyoone Derii mela gideedda; worakanatuukka an simeretiino.
Shin abeet Med'inaa Godaw, neeni med'inaw kawutaasa; ne kawutetsaa araataykka yeletaa ubbaa gakkanaw de'ee.
Neeni nuuna ayaw ubbaa wode dogay? K'ay hawaa keeshshaa adussa wodiyaa nuuna ayaw aggay?
Abeet Med'inaa Godaw, nuuna neekko zaara; nuunikka simmana! Nu wodiyaakka beniwaadan zaaraadde ooratsa!
Neeni nuuna ubbaa mule aggaadiiyye? Ne hank'k'ookka zaway baaweeyye?
